name: biceps narrow pull-ups
description: A body weight row under a low bar with a narrow underhand grip. It emphasises the biceps and the upper back.
instructions: Set a bar at about waist height and lie underneath it.
Grip it with your palms facing you and your hands close together.
Straighten your body from head to heels, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up to the bar, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
